bio_html: Subhrajit (Jit) Choudhury is a PhD student in Public Management and Policy at Georgia State University's Andrew Young School of Policy Studies, contributing expertise in public administration theory, experimental economics, and federal workforce data. He previously served in the West Bengal Civil Services and holds an MSc in Financial Economics from the Madras School of Economics.
